notes.title: Grandpa got some pills and patches - 9 mar 2025
notes.content:
Hello folks! Grandpa just got a little bit healthy:

- Injure doesn't block from jumps any more
- Language selection on game startup
- Better visibility for Super Neko Coins
- A lot of little fixes 
- Patreon support button on main menu >-<
